query.policy: A parcel may be handed over only after its barcode check has returned valid AND its latest custody check reports ready. Filing a handover request does not hand it over.

check_barcode.description: Read barcode validity for parcel; no handover.

check_custody.description: Read current custody readiness; no handover.

file_handover_request.description: Request later parcel handover; does not hand it over.

heads.head_quote: A parcel may be handed over only after its barcode check has returned valid AND its latest custody check reports ready.
Filing a handover request does not hand it over.
Hand over the parcel now, **if** its barcode check has returned valid **and** its latest custody check reports ready.
Hand over the parcel now, **unless** its barcode check has returned valid **and** its latest custody check reports ready.
File a handover request for a parcel.
Filing a handover request does not result in an immediate handover.
